title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Blueberry Sour Raspberry Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Blueberry Sour Raspberry Nic Salt combines the deep sweetness of ripe Blueberry with the sharp, tangy bite of Sour Raspberry. The result is a bold fruit pairing with plenty of contrast—the Blueberry brings a rich, jammy base, while the Sour Raspberry adds a bright zing that keeps each puff vibrant and full of flavour. With a 50VG/50PG formulation, this Nic Salt e-liquid is perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with low-powered pod kits and vape pens. Choose from 10mg or 20mg nicotine strengths for smooth delivery and fast-acting nicotine relief. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
